summary: @benwerd it cost next to nothing but I have seen the handheld Oregon Trail Game unit bring happiness, and more importantly help pass time, from 8-80. Plus your family comes with you. Granted they die of dissentery but they were with you through the thick and thin.

body_html:
@benwerd it cost next to nothing but I have seen the handheld Oregon Trail Game unit bring happiness, and more importantly help pass time, from 8-80.

Plus your family comes with you. Granted they die of dissentery but they were with you through the thick and thin.
